inputs.text: This account says more about the priorities of sanctuary-policy defenders than it does about DHS. They call enforcement a “political weapon” and warn about state power, but the basic question is whether local policies are making it harder for authorities to enforce the law and protect the public. No one should condemn an entire community—but neither should officials use that principle to excuse policies that weaken lawful enforcement. Public safety and respect for the law must come before ideological posturing.
